capabilities.justification: The native verifier reads bounded owner, DACL, reparse-point, and file-identity metadata without following links before install or discovery.
Stages the exact snapshot and grants its ephemeral AppContainer access only to that private directory.
Starts the checked-in launcher in either fail-closed ACL verification mode or sandbox-supervisor mode.
Creates one suspended child and assigns it to the single-process Job Object before any plugin code runs.
Terminates the Job Object when cancellation or a resource boundary requires retirement.

justification: Applies the explicit Windows AppContainer, restricted-token, mitigation, and Job Object boundary around an exact host-verified plugin snapshot.
